title: Absorption Probabilities for Random Convex Hulls: Distribution-Freeness via the Wall-Crossing Method
summary: We consider the probability that the convex hull of the first $n$ partial sums of a $d$-dimensional random walk contains the origin. Under symmetric exchangeability of the increments and a general-position assumption, this absorption probability is distribution-free and admits an explicit formula, previously obtained by Kabluchko, Vysotsky and Zaporozhets [Geom. Funct. Anal. 27 (2017)] using characteristic polynomials of hyperplane arrangements. We give a different proof, based on a wall-crossing method which we develop here.
